title: BenchMeUp: Building Software Engineering Benchmarks from Natural-Language Specifications
abstract: arXiv:2610.37283v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software-engineering research relies on benchmarks that evaluate new techniques on a set of problem instances. Unfortunately, manually constructing benchmarks is labor-intensive, as researchers must find suitable instances, prepare execution environments, establish expected outcomes, and validate correctness.   This paper presents BenchMeUp, an approach for automatically creating software-engineering benchmarks from natural-language specifications. Given a specification defining the desired instances, data sources, and evaluation procedures, BenchMeUp generates search rules and a construction plan, invokes parallel LLM agents that identify candidate instances and construct executable instances, validates the results in fresh execution environments, and packages the instances behind a unified command-line interface. We evaluate the approach on four tasks: program repair, issue reproduction, compiler autotuning, and fixing static-analysis

translated_title: BenchMeUp：从自然语言规范构建软件工程基准测试
translated_abstract: 软件工程研究依赖于在一系列问题实例上评估新技术的基准测试。遗憾的是，手动构建基准测试非常耗费人力，因为研究人员必须寻找合适的实例、准备执行环境、建立预期结果并验证正确性。本文提出了BenchMeUp，一种从自然语言规范自动创建软件工程基准测试的方法。给定一个定义了所需实例、数据源和评估流程的规范，BenchMeUp会生成搜索规则和构建计划，调用并行的大语言模型（LLM）智能体来识别候选实例并构建可执行的实例，在全新的执行环境中验证结果，并通过统一的命令行接口封装这些实例。我们在四项任务上评估了该方法：程序修复、问题复现、编译器自动调优以及修复静态分析（相关任务）。
tldr: 本文提出BenchMeUp方法，可从自然语言规范自动构建软件工程基准测试，通过并行LLM智能体识别并构建可执行实例、在新环境中验证正确性，从而大幅降低基准测试构建的人工成本。
en_tdlr: This paper presents BenchMeUp, an approach that automatically builds software-engineering benchmarks from natural-language specifications by invoking parallel LLM agents to identify, construct, and validate executable instances in fresh execution environments, thereby greatly reducing the manual labor of benchmark construction.
